All four pages retain content, menu links and a usable 320px layout with JavaScript disabled.
Malformed, truncated and foreign video URLs cannot expose a broken player.
Exact video IDs and supported YouTube URL formats prepare an accessible local cover without loading a player.
Non-finite duration is omitted rather than announced as invalid minutes.
Configured video exposes its current local 1280x720 cover and duration while making no third-party request before play.
Keyboard play loads only a fixture of the privacy-enhanced YouTube player, muted with Turkish caption preference.
Chrome Web Store action requests the configured canonical destination; the response uses a fixture.

visualReview.scope: Earlier completed review of 38 unchanged home component, document intro, and 404 layouts is carried forward; final published-video configuration adds four reviewed video section images and two re-reviewed current connection images. The browser suite regenerated all 72 captures from the stable final sources.
notes: Claude Design typography, palette, visible grid, square borders and page structure are preserved.
390 and 1440 pixel light/dark sections are readable; all 320/390/768/1024/1440 page and theme combinations have no horizontal overflow.
Current 1440 by 2359 settings images include the connection summary, draft/save state, prompt and setup guide without cropping their controls.
Section images use native full-page clipping from scroll position zero, without product style or DOM masking.
Quill editor images show the deterministic mocked correction flow and are not evidence of live provider correction quality.
Final video cover and 0:32 label are visible in both themes at mobile and desktop widths; the player request uses the real published video ID but is answered by a local fixture.

limitations: This suite validates local Chromium pages served with the site security headers; it does not independently verify deployed Cloudflare output.

YouTube player and Chrome Web Store requests are intercepted deterministic fixtures. Actual YouTube playback, HD selection, Turkish captions and publication state were observed separately by the root agent and are not claimed by this local suite.
No paid provider inference, real credentials, account browser, or user Chrome profile were used.
